coverage_note: The readable opening sets up the question - 'if you win the lottery then you will be rich' as L -> R, with converse R -> L - and begins matching a list of English statements (a to i) against the implication and its converse. Most of the statement-by-statement matching was past the cut.
concepts: Set the given implication and its converse side by side before comparing anything: L -> R versus R -> L.
Each candidate English statement is translated and then compared with the two formulas.
'Either you win the lottery or you will not be rich' is read as 'if you do not win the lottery then you will not be rich', i.e. as a restatement of L -> R.
